tagline: Leading UK financial services group managing retirement savings at scale.
hero_kpi_rationale: Legal & General is a UK financial services leader specializing in retirement management. Total Assets Under Management (1.2 trillion pounds) is the central driver of its business model, reflecting its position as a major defined contribution retirement provider with 5.4 million members.

kpis.name: Assets Under Management
kpis.explanation: Total value of assets managed by the company for its clients.
kpis.description: AUM reached 1.2 trillion pounds in H1 2024, with strong international exposure (approximately 0.5 trillion pounds).
kpis.signal: 1.2 trillion pounds in AUM, approximately 40% internationally.

kpis.name: Defined Contribution AUM
kpis.explanation: Assets under management dedicated to UK defined contribution pension schemes.
kpis.description: DC AUM stands at 176 billion pounds, positioning L&G as the undisputed leader in UK defined contribution pensions.
kpis.signal: Largest UK defined contribution pension provider with 176 billion pounds in AUM.

kpis.name: Mastertrust AUM
kpis.explanation: AUM of the Mastertrust collective pension fund, the UK's largest commercial fund.
kpis.description: Mastertrust reached 30 billion pounds in AUM as of January 1, 2025, up from 20 billion pounds less than two years ago, marking one-third growth in two years.
kpis.signal: First commercial Mastertrust fund to reach 30 billion pounds, 50% growth in under two years.

kpis.name: Total Members
kpis.explanation: Total number of individuals whose retirement savings are managed by L&G.
kpis.description: L&G manages retirement savings for 5.4 million people in total across the UK.

kpis.name: Mastertrust Members
kpis.explanation: Number of individuals whose pensions are managed through the Mastertrust fund.
kpis.description: Mastertrust covers 1.9 million people across the UK.
kpis.signal: 1.9 million members in Mastertrust, representing 35% of total L&G.

kpis.name: Participating Employers
kpis.explanation: Number of companies using Mastertrust for employee pension schemes.
kpis.description: Mastertrust has 349 participating employers as of January 1, 2025.
kpis.signal: 349 employers use Mastertrust for employee pension schemes.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 582.27 billion EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 4.9 billion EUR in the latest year

kpis.name: Mastertrust AUM
kpis.explanation: AUM of the Mastertrust collective pension fund, the UK's largest commercial fund.
kpis.description: Mastertrust reached 30 billion pounds in AUM as of January 1, 2025, up from 20 billion pounds less than two years ago, marking one-third growth in two years.
kpis.signal: First commercial Mastertrust fund to reach 30 billion pounds, 50% growth in under two years.
